title: Act 4: Echos of the Past
changeNote:
## 1.4.0 Changes

- Corrupted Players now carry a character buff: Singeing Ichor (Ironclad), Ring of the Viper (Silent), Tarnished Crown (Regent), Fractured Urn (Necrobinder) and Overvolted Matrix (Defect).
- At Ascension 9 and above, Corrupted Players also gain Echo Shard: +1 energy at the start of each turn.
- Corrupted Player hand previews overlap cards so up to 10 fit without scrolling; the scroll arrows are removed.
- Corrupted Player hands now animate like the player's hand: cards are drawn from their draw pile one at a time, kept cards slide into place, discards fly to their discard pile and exhausted cards burn away.
- Corrupted Player hands now rest directly on each Corrupted Player's health bar, centered over it, instead of above its head.
- Corrupted Player energy, stars and draw, discard and exhaust piles now show as compact icons ahead of its buffs below the health bar. Hover them for details; click a pile to view it.
- Corrupted Players with no cards in hand no longer show a "No cards" label.
- Corrupted Players have larger target hitboxes, making them easier to click.
- Increased Corrupted Player HP to 3.5 times saved maximum HP at Ascension 0-7 and 4.1 times at Ascension 8+.
- Every co-op participant now saves the complete Corrupted Party locally, so anyone in the group can host the next run against the same opponents.
- Fixed Whistle and other stuns targeting a player in Corrupted Player fights: the player now gains Stunned and cannot draw cards until the end of their next turn, but can still play cards, use potions and end the turn.
- Renamed the Ritual Dagger relic to Forgotten Ritual.
- The Architect's intents sit lower on screen.
- Fixed Corrupted Players stopping mid-fight in three- and four-player runs: native enemy block scaling had no Act 4 tier and threw every time they gained block.
- Corrupted Player hand cards drawn over another creature now still respond to hover, and only one enlarged card is shown at a time.
- The corrupted Regent renders slightly smaller so his hand preview clears the relic bar.
- Custom power icons now load their own art instead of the missing-icon placeholder.
